query: 企业风险管理（ERM）框架 企业风险管理（ERM）框架 衡量企业识别、评估、应对与监控综合风险（含战略、运营、财务、合规及ESG风险）的体系成熟度与披露完备性。 2分 全面披露且体系闭环：同时满足以下四项中的至少三项（其中第1项为必要条件）： （1）董事会或下设专门委员会（如风险管理委员会）明确承担风险管理监督职责，并披露年度检讨频率； （2）披露系统化的风险识别与评估流程（如风险清单、风险热力图、量化评估标准）； （3）披露风险应对策略（如风险规避、转移、缓释、接受）及责任归属； （4）披露风险监控与报告机制（如定期向董事会/委员会汇报、内审验证、整改追踪）。 企业管治报告/ESG报告/年报中有明确描述，且内容具体、可验证 1分 部分披露或制度不完整：满足上述四项标准中的1-2项（若仅满足第1项但缺乏后续流程描述，仍为1分），或虽提及风险管理但缺乏具体机制描述（如仅声明“本公司高度重视风险管理”而无具体架构/流程）。 有相关披露但内容不够完整，缺乏可验证的具体信息 0分 未披露或仅形式披露：未披露风险管理相关信息，或仅以“本公司建立了风险管理制度”等笼统表述一笔带过，无任何实质性内容。 无法从公开披露中获取有效信息 企业风险管理 全面风险管理 风险管理委员会 风险偏好 风险热力图 重大风险 三道防线 风险清单 风险应对 ERM 3LOD enterprise risk management ERM risk committee risk appetite risk heat map principal risks three lines of defence risk register risk response 3LOD 董事会或风险管理委员会如何监督并披露检讨频率？ 风险识别与评估流程（清单、热力图、量化标准）是什么？ 风险应对策略与责任归属如何规定？ 监控报告、内审验证与整改追踪如何运作？ 是否覆盖战略运营财务合规及ESG综合风险？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '企业风险管理（ERM）框架'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 董事会或风险管理委员会如何监督并披露检讨频率？ 风险识别与评估流程（清单、热力图、量化标准）是什么？ 风险应对策略与责任归属如何规定？ 监控报告、内审验证与整改追踪如何运作？ 是否覆盖战略运营财务合规及ESG综合风险？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有单一气候风险段落；仅有网络安全专题；仅有“重视风险管理”口号；仅有内控自我评价无ERM框架；区分：ERM是综合企业风险管理框架；气候物理/转型风险与网络安全治理是专题风险，可作ERM组成部分，但不能单独替代ERM闭环披露。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: Effective management of environmental, social and ethical risks the freight forwarding business faces is a prime concern of the Group and to address this issue, we use internal controls and risk management systems. The Board of Directors is responsible for identifying ESG risks including climate-related risks, whereas the management is responsible for evaluating the effectiveness of the internal control and risk management system and reports to the Board and the Audit Committee on a yearly basis. BOARD STATEMENT

[Content]
Effective management of environmental, social and ethical risks the freight forwarding business faces is a prime concern of the Group and to address this issue, we use internal controls and risk management systems. The Board of Directors is responsible for identifying ESG risks including climate-related risks, whereas the management is responsible for evaluating the effectiveness of the internal control and risk management system and reports to the Board and the Audit Committee on a yearly basis. The Group incorporates material ESG topics in its management system to ensure effective risk management.

results.text: In order to reduce the ESG risks in the supply chain, we carry out due diligence in the supplier selection process. During procurement, we invite more than one quotation and conduct detailed background checks. We take social and environmental performance in aspects such as environmental protection, occupational health and safety and quality assurance etc., into consideration in the process of supplier selection. We also assign department managers to monitor vendors' performance regularly. An annual assessment review is conducted to ensure services or product quality of existing suppliers are in line with the Group's standards and expectations.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE / Supply Chain Management

[Content]
In order to reduce the ESG risks in the supply chain, we carry out due diligence in the supplier selection process. During procurement, we invite more than one quotation and conduct detailed background checks. We take social and environmental performance in aspects such as environmental protection, occupational health and safety and quality assurance etc., into consideration in the process of supplier selection. We also assign department managers to monitor vendors' performance regularly. An annual assessment review is conducted to ensure services or product quality of existing suppliers are in line with the Group's standards and expectations.

results.text: Greenhouse gas ('GHG') emissions from our business operations include direct emissions from fuel consumption (Scope 1), indirect emissions from the use of electricity (Scope 2) and other indirect emissions from business travel by air, paper disposal at landfills, freshwater processing and sewage treatment (Scope 3). During the year, the Group's total GHG emissions were 301.1 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent (tCO 2 e), with an emission intensity of 0.08 tCO 2 e per square meter of floor area. The GHG emissions were mainly contributed by emissions from the use of electricity, which constituted around 62% of total GHG emissions.

[Section]
Resources Consumption / 2021 Energy Consumption (MWh)

[Content]
Greenhouse gas ('GHG') emissions from our business operations include direct emissions from fuel consumption (Scope 1), indirect emissions from the use of electricity (Scope 2) and other indirect emissions from business travel by air, paper disposal at landfills, freshwater processing and sewage treatment (Scope 3). During the year, the Group's total GHG emissions were 301.1 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent (tCO 2 e), with an emission intensity of 0.08 tCO 2 e per square meter of floor area. The GHG emissions were mainly contributed by emissions from the use of electricity, which constituted around 62% of total GHG emissions.

The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.

results.text: An effective supply chain management is critical for our business. Air freight as well as ocean freight services involve various vendors including airline companies, shipping line companies, carriers, co-loaders, transportation companies and related business agents. The Group values its relationships with suppliers and puts in efforts to maintain long-term and stable business relations. A Vendor Committee is formed by the top management team, corporate function heads, stations management heads and departmental management heads, to oversee and ensure smooth vendor selection and appointment. Our Vendor Management Policy offers guidelines on procurement of services and products from third parties.

[Content]
An effective supply chain management is critical for our business. Air freight as well as ocean freight services involve various vendors including airline companies, shipping line companies, carriers, co-loaders, transportation companies and related business agents. The Group values its relationships with suppliers and puts in efforts to maintain long-term and stable business relations. A Vendor Committee is formed by the top management team, corporate function heads, stations management heads and departmental management heads, to oversee and ensure smooth vendor selection and appointment. Our Vendor Management Policy offers guidelines on procurement of services and products from third parties.
